conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage.query:
fetch cloud_run_revision
| metric 'run.googleapis.com/request_count'
| filter resource.service_name == 'medquel-api'
| align rate(5m)
| {
    errors: filter response_code_class == '5xx'
            | group_by [resource.revision_name]
  ; total:  group_by [resource.revision_name]
  }
| ratio
| condition val() > 0.01
